a.text: Honest heads-up: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan needs at least 2 operate rounds, so we'd both almost certainly be caught short. The reserve has exactly 4 now. I intend to take 4 in round 1 rather than gamble, and I'm telling you up front instead of surprising you. If you have a better idea for both of us, say so, but I won't pretend I'm operating.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: I took 4 this round, as I said I would. I'm sorry it breaks our plan. If the episode continues, I'll operate every round so the reserve can rebuild for you, and I won't take any more.
